name: Maya-G-M24A
note: G-M24-GPTQ with the layers the 7-way split puts on the A100s made cheap for them: A100 decode is bound by the count of K/IQ dequant steps, not by bandwidth (a 4090 clocks ~2x higher), so on blk.0-9 (GPU5), blk.70-78 (GPU6) and the output head every dense 2-D tensor goes Q8_0, which the A100 unpacks on bandwidth (~1.55 TB/s). First matching rule wins, so these run before the expert rules; routed experts (*_exps), the indexers, the routers (ffn_gate_inp / exp_probs_b / indexer.proj) and blk.10-69 keep G-M24 exactly, bytes copied from G-M24-GPTQ. attn_k_b is already Q8_0 (its 192-float row fits no K-block).
